ablation.name: phase4i1a_eota_per_subband_multi_alpha
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.1a: EOTA + per_subband + multi-scale alpha (LH=0.5, HL=0.5, HH=0.9). STRUCTURAL BREAKTHROUGH attempt. Theory: single alpha forces all frequencies to trade off along the same 1D Pareto frontier. Multi-scale alpha introduces NEW degrees of freedom: LH/HL (mid-freq structure) use small alpha to preserve content, HH (high-freq detail) uses large alpha for strong style. HH carries detail style (brush edges) with minimal content impact. Base: 4H.1c (per_subband EOTA alpha=0.7, clip=0.7280, lpips=0.3442). Goal: break Pareto frontier, achieve BOTH higher clip AND lower lpips.
